notes: Datasheet code printed on page 1: 'Pylontech datesheet-PY21US05-1' (spelling as printed). No date printed.

The manufacturer's own sites (en.pylontech.com.cn and regional sites) render downloads through JavaScript only; no direct manufacturer-hosted PDF URL could be obtained, so the Segen distributor copy was used.
Design life printed '15+ Years (25/77)' - read as 25 °C / 77 °F with the degree symbols lost in text extraction.
Short-circuit current printed '<4000A/2ms'. IP20. Communication RS485, CAN. Natural cooling. Breaker: US5000 No, US5000-B Yes.
Standards printed: IEC62619, IEC63056, CE, UN38.3, UL1973, UKCA (US5000-B adds CEC).
Other sources disagree on cycle life (some catalogues say >8000) and weight (operation manual 39.7 kg); this file records only this datasheet.
